name: Amanda Campbell

summary.text: Amanda Campbell is the American Constitution Party candidate for Colorado Secretary of State on the November 3, 2026 ballot.
She works as a program secretary for Meals on Wheels of Mesa County in Grand Junction, according to The Ballot Brief, citing iVoterGuide.
She has also been the American Constitution Party's Secretary of State nominee in 2014, 2018, 2020 and 2022.

experience.text: Previous American Constitution Party nominee for Colorado Secretary of State in 2014, 2018, 2020 and 2022; has never held elected office.

finance.note: No campaign committee is registered with the Colorado Secretary of State as of October 16, 2026, so there are no totals to report.

research_notes: Campbell did not respond to the Colorado Politics 2026 candidate questionnaire ('American Constitution Party candidate Amanda Campbell did not respond') or the Denver Post's separate 2026 candidate Q&A ('James Wiley and Amanda Campbell did not return the questionnaire'), and has not completed a Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey in 2020, 2022 or 2026. No 2026 campaign website was found (The Ballot Brief notes none existed as of September 8, 2026). Her only own-words statement I could fetch is from her 2022 campaign website, a general statement about constitutional government that does not map clearly to any of the 25 statements, so no positions were coded for her -- all are correctly left unknown rather than inferred from party or old material. A reviewer should re-check for a current website or interview closer to the election. Second pass 2026-10-14: re-searched news coverage and Google News for additional Amanda Campbell material; found nothing beyond what was already sourced (she did not respond to the Denver Post's Oct. 3, 2026 or Colorado Politics' Oct. 2, 2026 questionnaires). No new positions were added.
